title: GHSL AI-agent index lists mutable-ref TOCTOU in MongoDB connection-string release workflow
ai_system: GitHub Security Lab AI agent (system not named in advisory)
summary: The release workflow authorizes a maintainer and then checks out a mutable pull-request ref, allowing an external contributor to change the code before scripts run with a write-scoped repository token.
ai_role: GHSL’s primary AI-agent index includes this advisory in its AI-discovered list. The item advisory credits the human researcher only and does not detail an agent’s role; attribution is index-level only.
classification_note: The advisory documents the race and fix; it does not claim exploitation in the wild.
remediation_note: GHSL reports a fix on 2026-09-03; see advisory for implementation details.

impacts.conditions: A mutable release-workflow ref can be changed between validation and use; if job then executes fetched code, this is code execution in the workflow context.
impacts.exploitation: The cited source does not establish exploitation in the wild.
